bathAction.title: Clean crotch nipples deeper
bathAction.tooltip: Rinse inside the crotch nipples. Unavailable while they are plugged or sealed.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(lift)] [npc.her] [npc.breastsCrotch] and [npc.verb(work)] warm water into the nipples, rinsing out what had gathered inside. Whatever was inside threads away into the water. [npc.She] [npc.verb(take)] each one in turn. [npc.speech(These too. They store more than the ones on my chest.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(cup)] [npc.her] [npc.breastsCrotch] and [npc.verb(work)] hot water into the nipples, slow, moaning when they start to give up what they were holding. [npc.speech(Oh. Deeper. They ache when they are full.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(squeeze)] the crotch nipples and [npc.verb(flush)] them until they run clear, then [npc.verb(let)] them go. [npc.speech(Empty. I am not carrying that around.)]
